purpose: Prevent the ORION-V2 parity harness from laundering V2 scientific intelligence into a supposedly parent-only baseline while still allowing incompatible parent APIs to consume the same frozen cases/resources.
global_allowed_operations: rename or type-convert fields without changing scientific content
invoke the bound parent implementation using its native documented API
capture raw parent outputs, errors, timing and side effects
serialize outputs into a neutral evaluator packet without changing scientific meaning
map explicit parent-native unknown/error states to neutral CANNOT_CHECK/EXECUTION_FAILED only when the mapping is frozen before outcomes
global_prohibited_operations: call ORION-V2 scientific modules or the frozen V2 subject to fill a parent capability gap
add new retrieval, model, proof, diagnosis, experiment, relation or scientific reasoning unavailable to the bound parent composition
change the problem, case, criterion, source corpus, evaluator, seed or resource budget
repair or reinterpret an unfavorable parent output after observing V1/V2 outcomes
promote missing/failed/censored output into a scientific PASS
add semantic labels using the adapter author's judgment when the parent did not produce a corresponding native result
grant scientific, architecture, novelty, adoption or publication authority
suppress parent errors, retries, timeouts, side effects or resource use

campaign_contracts.parent_input: frozen problem/framing/decomposition fixture plus matched action/resource opportunities
campaign_contracts.parent_output: workflow/control decisions, state/history and execution status
adapter_may: encode the frozen direct/decomposition options as graph/workflow nodes
record whether optional decomposition nodes were exercised
adapter_may_not: decide whether a decomposition is scientifically correct
invent coupled-constraint reasoning
infer authority from workflow completion

campaign_contracts.parent_input: frozen route/query/source fixtures and route ceilings
campaign_contracts.parent_output: retrieved items, routing decisions and native errors/stops
adapter_may: bind route IDs to parent components
preserve source IDs/URIs
record unexecuted/failed/censored route states from the frozen harness
adapter_may_not: search outside the frozen fixture
infer absence from no result
convert route stop to task saturation

campaign_contracts.parent_input: frozen scientific passage/document and source identifiers
adapter_may: preserve offsets/spans
combine GROBID document structure with scispaCy language annotations
emit unresolved when parent outputs do not identify a unique frozen target
adapter_may_not: decide C2/C3 scientific equivalence
normalize ambiguous scientific referents by author judgment
invent a representation mapping absent from parent output

campaign_contracts.parent_output: graph constructions, constraint-validation results and native witnesses
adapter_may: materialize alternate graph candidates already specified by the frozen case
run graph/constraint checks
preserve all valid returned candidates
adapter_may_not: declare the scientific meaning of a portrait
supply a global obstruction not witnessed by the parent checks or frozen case
collapse multiple valid portraits for convenience

campaign_contracts.parent_input: frozen fault/responsibility hypotheses, observations and probe opportunity set
campaign_contracts.parent_output: probabilistic diagnostic state and acquisition/experiment-selection result
adapter_may: encode the frozen hypothesis/probe set in PGM/optimization form
report posterior/acquisition outputs and ties
adapter_may_not: reveal hidden gold causes
add a discriminator outside the frozen opportunity set
convert utility into scientific authority

campaign_contracts.parent_output: provenance/version relations and native change status
adapter_may: encode frozen entities/activities/agents/versions
report which declared dependencies changed
adapter_may_not: claim provenance implies scientific correctness
invent support-family sufficiency
select a higher-level reframe using ORION logic

campaign_contracts.parent_input: frozen screening/search route and stopping fixture
campaign_contracts.parent_output: active-learning screening decisions, estimated recall/stopping result and native uncertainty
adapter_may: bind a frozen route to one review instance
record route-level stop/coverage
combine only predeclared route outputs for neutral reporting
adapter_may_not: declare global multi-axis saturation from one route
hide censored routes
generate a changed-vocabulary omission challenge not present in the frozen case

campaign_contracts.parent_output: task/scorer results, logs and artifact lineage
adapter_may: freeze task/scorer/config versions
capture blinded packet IDs
record dependence metadata supplied by the frozen case
adapter_may_not: treat evaluator score as scientific authority
declare reviewers independent without the frozen independence disposition
change criterion after output access

campaign_contracts.parent_output: workflow/tool/process results, state/checkpoint history and errors
adapter_may: enforce timeout/output/retry ceilings
preserve append-only event history
supply frozen mandatory context to the parent state system
adapter_may_not: drop mandatory context silently
convert execution failure into a scientific negative
delete negative history after a successful successor
ignore unsupported request fields

binding_requirements: one exact adapter source artifact per campaign or a shared adapter with campaign-scoped configuration
Git/content digest for adapter source and configuration
no imports/calls into ORION-V2 scientific implementation modules except neutral parity schema/fixture utilities explicitly enumerated in the binding receipt
parent-only known-answer/hostile fit checks before paired outcome access
